title: TD Marketing: Antonio's own dashboard with one menu, and What's New for the team
text: Antonio's Marketing section in the CRM now has one menu for every Marketing screen, Documents included, and a Home where he can act: give a lead to a person or a team, answer messages in place, send a private reminder, and upload documents. The team also gets a What's New page: Antonio posts or approves announcements of new screens, and the team sees them with a red number in the menu.
points: Antonio sees Read by N of M for every post, and who has not read it yet.
A new screen added to the team workspace waits as a draft until Antonio approves or discards its announcement.
Posts can carry an Italian version and also go out as a push notification to their audience.
